hints.title: Earliest Ending Substring
hints.text: Valid substrings have length at least 4 and identical first and last characters.

hints.title: Greedy Interval Selection
hints.text: In interval scheduling, committing to the earliest ending valid substring leaves the maximum room for subsequent substrings.

hints.title: State Reset on Match
hints.text: Record first occurrence indices and clear state immediately upon closing the earliest valid interval.

hints.title: Reference Implementation

complexity.whyNaiveFails: Examining all non-intersecting combinations runs in exponential time.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Clearing character map upon match maintains constant auxiliary space.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Prove greedy finish-time optimality for disjoint interval packing.
